head: # Campaign 5: musespark-c1-p90-sa — intent and constraints
Written 2026-11-12 before launch (CLAUDE.md, autonomous mode). Source of truth: README.md "下面是第5个campaign" and the user's answers of 2026-11-12.
## Goal

Run a 24 h **Arbor standalone** campaign on Muse Spark Open with SGLang, MI355X, AgentX trace replay at **concurrency 1**, with **P90 interactivity** as the objective. Before and after the campaign, run the full AgentX benchmark at C1 and GSM8K (README item 8).
## Pins

| Arbor | AMD-AGI/Arbor branch `v0.9.2-baseline-test` = `2c2fd3df` (2026-11-10; backports up to F32), stock code + our pack `agentx-musespark-c1sa` |
| CI run | InferenceX run 38877885539 (2026-10-16), commit `8a76a78e41` (on refs/pull/4127), key `musespark-fp4-mi355x-sglang-agentic-dflash` |
| Recipe | `inferencex-e2e/benchmarks/single_node/srt-slurm-recipes/musespark/sglang/mi355x-fp4-mtp/agentic.yaml`, point `override_tp4_c1` (TP4/EP4, CONC 1) |

## Decisions (user, 2026-11-12)
- **Node:** a new hold job (285229, v3-189, submitted at 1 day, raised to 3 days once running; to 2026-11-15 23:20 UTC). Job 283952 released for it; job 280523 (v3-113) kept.
- **CI point:** `override_tp4_c1` (TP4/EP4); GPUs 4-7 free for Arbor's probes and profiling.

- **Bench client:** InferenceX 86699be610. Arbor v0.9.2's bench needs `benchmarks/benchmark_lib.sh`, which 8a76a78e41 (and 41cc713) no longer have. Absolute numbers therefore differ from CI's `infx` client; before, after and every iteration use the same client.
- **Before/after:** one full AgentX (C1, 3600 s) and one GSM8K (1319 questions, `sglang.test.few_shot_gsm8k`) each, on a fresh server.

- **DECISION (mine, from campaign 4's user decision; to report):** objective `e2e_norm_intvty_p90`, KEEP at +2 %, P50 held within 5 %. Arbor v0.9.2's second axis is a Pareto axis (`arbor/measure/gate.py`); configured as a guard: `secondary_threshold_rel` 1000 (never a gain), `secondary_noise_band_pct` 5, `secondary_regression_cap_pct` 5.
- **Interactivity metrics:** v0.9.2's agentx bench writes only throughput; our pack's bench adds `e2e_norm_intvty_p50/p90` from InferenceX's aggregate (the same lines as Arbor main 7c364d6).
## Known weaknesses of this Arbor (red flags reported to the user)

- No cold prefix cache before a bench (Arbor main has it): Arbor's own numbers carry the warm-server bias seen in campaign 3. Pack rule: book KEEPs on a restarted server. The before/after runs are the numbers of record.
- The spec's "Optimization Target" (total_throughput_per_gpu, C16) differs from item 3 (C1, P90); item 3 is followed.
## Layout

- `experiments/musespark-c1-p90-sa/`: this guide, `env.sh`, `dl.sh`, `prepare.sh`, `ab.sh` (smoke/before/after), `campaign.sh`, `stage/` (Arbor archive, pack, bench, config), `runs/<tag>/`, `sessions/full/`, `logs/`, `ctrl/` (node agent).
- Node NVMe `/mnt/m2m_nobackup/qiangh_muse5/hf-hub`: model, draft, corpus (refs/main = pins), mounted at `/hf-hub` in container `qh_c5sa`.
## Constraints

- Never touch other users' containers or processes (a foreign idle container `tremez-grpo` runs on v3-189). Smoke test first. Do not loosen gates, tolerances or CI flags without the user; record any CI deviation. No tokens (GitHub, board, HF) inside the container. Log every action in `reports/<date>_worklog.md`.
Terminated
